EMERGENCY (ESSENTIAL POWERS) ORDINANCE, 1969
(Ordinance 1 and Ordinance 2)
ESSENTIAL (INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS) REGULATIONS, 1969

IN exercise of the powers conferred under section 2 of the Emergency
(Essential Powers) Ordinance No. 1, 1969, the Director of Operations
designated under section 2 of the Emergency (Essential Powers) Ordi-
nance No. 2, 1969, hereby makes the following regulations:

1. These regulations may be cited as the Essential (Industrial Rela-
tions) Regulations, 1969.             !

2. For so long as the Emergency is in force the Industrial Relations
Act, 1967, shall have effect subject to the amendments made thereto
specified in the Schedule hereto.
